description.value: Fat Mao—meaning 'prosperous cat' in Cantonese—is a 25-seat open-kitchen noodle bar by Chef Angus An, the original location in Vancouver's Chinatown, specializing in Thai-style noodle soups such as Khao Soi, Boat Noodles, and Tom Yum Goong. The menu draws on Southeast Asian street-food traditions, with each dish built around a single noodle soup done with care and consistency. Cyclists passing through Chinatown will find a focused, hearty menu with both meat and vegetarian options.
